purpose: One completed signed-in Edge turn through the ordinary UI, recovered from a saved VMware network stream and rechecked in a later direct WinPmem acquisition.

ground_truth.source: Private guest-screen capture after the saved-memory state and before the direct acquisition; public synthetic-only crop is screenshots/22-signedin-edge-teapot-visible.png

network_service_sse_reconstruction.selection: Unique active msedge.exe with exact network.mojom.NetworkService utility subtype in image-derived command lines
structure: input_message carries conversation ID, user ID and complete prompt
system message parent ID equals user ID
assistant message parent ID equals system ID
three assistant message markers carry that assistant ID and conversation ID
four content patches append 15, 57, 47 and 36 characters
final batch marks finished_successfully and end_turn true
message_stream_complete carries the same conversation ID
network_service_sse_reconstruction.experimental_role: development result; grammar was written while studying this saved-memory state

saved_vmware_memory.memprocfs_volatility_page_samples: 160/160 matched across all five renderer maps; 32/32 matched in NetworkService
saved_vmware_memory.network_sse_record_occurrences_reread_by: 15/15 exact byte hashes and mapped physical translations matched

frozen_network_sse_method.interpretation: A later timepoint of the same turn, not a prospective new-prompt validation.

all_active_edge_process_sse_check.selection: Every msedge.exe row in image-derived windows.pslist with null ExitTime; roles checked against windows.cmdline
all_active_edge_process_sse_check.additional_nonrenderer_memprocfs_volatil: 48/48 matched across browser, crashpad, GPU, StorageService, SearchIndexer and wallet maps
all_active_edge_process_sse_check.method: Same frozen complete-event scanner and turn joiner, with no known conversation values supplied
all_active_edge_process_sse_check.scope: Resident user mappings of each active Edge process; no cross-process stitching or whole-physical-image turn recovery claimed

unattributed_physical_identity_scan.contrast_with_renderer_map: The renderer had six complete events; its additional assistant-context event crossed virtually adjacent but physically nonadjacent page spans and was not framed by the flat physical scan.
unattributed_physical_identity_scan.scope: Exploratory full-image physical-byte scan with identity mapping, without process attribution; not another independent memory capture

direct_winpmem_memory.memprocfs_record_occurrences_pid_5844: 12/12 exact bytes and physical translations matched

posthoc_same_virtual_address_comparison.question: Were the 15 complete NetworkService events from saved VMware memory still present at those exact process virtual addresses in the later direct image?
posthoc_same_virtual_address_comparison.scope: Same signed-in turn, same Edge NetworkService PID 2936 and matching process creation metadata; two timepoints, not an independent new-prompt trial.
posthoc_same_virtual_address_comparison.reference: The 15 bounded event hashes, lengths and virtual/physical spans from the saved VMware image; no prompt or answer supplied to the comparison.
posthoc_same_virtual_address_comparison.later_source: The hash-verified direct WinPmem raw image and PID 2936 windows.memmap from that image.
posthoc_same_virtual_address_comparison.interpretation: The later zero-event result was not caused solely by those virtual addresses becoming unmapped. Their bytes changed; nine ranges even retained the same physical mapping. This comparison cannot assign a precise overwrite or reuse mechanism or claim that all copies of the earlier stream were erased.

posthoc_known_value_diagnostic_on_direct.other_three_active_renderer_maps: Zero exact full-value matches in both encodings
posthoc_known_value_diagnostic_on_direct.counting_note: Mapped occurrences may alias physical pages; none of these counts joins a user message to an assistant response.

privacy.public_screenshot: synthetic prompt and response only; deterministic crop, not AI-generated
